Floating action

.dr-fab · .dr-main--fab · components/button.css · components/frame.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

LanguageEnglish
Member since2026
Edit profile
  1. 1.dr-fabThe capsule. A primary button with position, the 999 pill radius (--len-999), 20px side padding and --shadow-raised added; centred on the frame with left:50% and translateX(-50%). Its bottom sits at 102 (60 + 30 + 12): the tab bar's 60 row and the 30 home strip, then 12 of air, which leaves it 11px clear of the tab bar's 1px hairline.
  2. 2.dr-icAn optional leading glyph, 20px, drawn in the label's charcoal. Green is never the ink and never the stroke.
  3. 3.dr-rowsCopied from account: the column the capsule floats over.
  4. 4.dr-main--fabThe other half of the component: the scrolling column gives back 72px of padding-bottom (44 + 12 + 16) so its last row scrolls clear of the capsule. All three screens that draw the capsule put it on their <main>.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Floating action.

When to use

The floating action is the screen's primary action when that screen is a tab root and has no action bar. It floats clear above the tab bar in the iOS 26 bottom-accessory slot, the capsule the Music mini-player rides in. HIG · Tab bars keeps actions out of the bar, so a circular button planted in or over it is the reading that fails. It stands on wallet, account and operator-account, and it is still .dr-btn--primary: the fill, ink, 44 height and press are the primary button's, so it is the screen's one green control.

It is one of three things in the product that take --shadow-raised, with the sheet and the toast, because it is over the page rather than in it. The cost is recorded rather than hidden: on operator-account the pill is 2.06% of the frame and 84.5% of the screen's green; on wallet, with the balance card, solid green reaches 11.32% against the ~5% ceiling, a departure the designer was shown and kept.

The label is a verb and its object, with the amount where there is one: Withdraw ₴3,240, Edit profile. No exclamation marks, no successfully.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The floating action · § Elevation & Depth · inventory.md § 1 (Floating action) · microcopy.md § wallet · voice.md P3

Rule and anti-rule

Do

LanguageEnglish
Member since2026
Withdraw ₴3,240

One capsule per screen, over a column that wears .dr-main--fab, on a tab-root screen with no action bar. The column's 72px floor keeps the last row reachable (WCAG 2.4.11).

Don’t

LanguageEnglish
Member since2026
Contact support

A capsule over a column that does not give the space back parks on the last row, and a secondary job spent as the screen's green control. On a screen with an action bar, the primary goes in the action bar as a block button; a second action is a secondary button, never a second floating one.
